reason: My clients hand me a bag of crumpled paper nota at month end, not a tidy chat, and everything I do has to land in Jurnal or Accurate. A Google Sheet is just one more place I'd have to copy from, so this adds work instead of removing it.
objection: My clients will not want a bot sitting in their group chats, and even if they did, it doesn't push anything into Jurnal or Accurate, which is where the job actually has to end up.
would_change_my_mind: A direct export or import file for Jurnal / Accurate, plus a way to snap photos of the paper nota myself without putting a bot in my clients' chats.
